Soft pieces

Lentil and carrot bites

Répás vöröslencsés falatok

8 months+ Adjusted 40 min 4 portions

These are a great source of iron. Serve the soft bites warm.

Freezes well.

Ingredients

  • 80 g red lentils (rinsed)
  • 1 medium carrot (grated)
  • 120 g sweet potato (peeled and diced)
  • 300 ml water (plain)
  • 1 egg (cooked through in the oven)
  • 10 g mild hard cheese (pasteurized and finely grated, not cheddar)
  • 1 tsp coriander (chopped, optional)

Allergens

eggmilk

Method

  1. Simmer the lentils, carrot, and sweet potato in the water until very soft and the lentils have collapsed.
  2. Drain any extra liquid and mash until almost smooth.
  3. Stir in the egg, the mild cheese, and the coriander if you want it, and do not use cheddar.
  4. Shape small flat bites and bake at 190 C until the egg is set and the outside is still soft.
  5. Do not fry them, then cool and squash one to check the texture.

Adjusted

Cheddar is very salty for this age, and frying would put a hard crust on an iron-rich bite. The lentils and vegetables have to be fully soft before they are shaped.

Cook red lentils, carrot, and sweet potato until soft, then bind them with egg and a small amount of mild pasteurized cheese, or skip the cheese. Bake the bites instead of frying them, and add coriander only if you want it.
